name: Baoli
detailed_description:
Key Features

  • Exploration and Puzzle Solving: The player, as Arjun, will explore these environments, searching for clues and solving puzzles to progress the narrative. This includes finding keys, using dates as passwords, decoding Morse code, and potentially deciphering number lock hints.

  • Unreliable Narrator and Hallucinations: A central element of the psychological horror is the unreliable nature of Arjun's perception due to his drug use and the potential for hallucinations, particularly the presence and actions of his friend. This blurring of reality and illusion will be a key source of tension and confusion for the player.

  • Environmental Storytelling: The state of the environments, such as the messy hostel room and the dusty house, along with items like the smiling photograph of Arjun and his brother, contribute to the narrative and provide insights into Arjun's mental state and his relationship with his brother.

  • Supernatural Elements: The appearance of a scary ghost resembling Arjun's friend introduces a potential supernatural threat, further blurring the lines between reality and hallucination. The "fear meter" and heartbeat sound during encounters with the ghost will add to the horror experience.

  •  Email as a Narrative Device: The changing content of the mysterious email serves as a crucial plot point, suggesting an external force at play and escalating Arjun's fear and paranoia. The email also provides potential clues, such as the alphanumeric patient ID.

  •  Flashbacks and Memory Sequences: Triggered by events or locations, brother's death flashback will provide fragmented glimpses into Arjun's past, particularly his relationship with his brother and a potentially traumatic event at the baoli.

short_description: Arjun, a young man grappling with the mysterious disappearance of his brother and his own struggles with drug use, players must unravel the mystery behind his brother’s disappearance, confront terrifying visions, and explore the ominous secrets of Baoli, an ancient stepwell with a dark past.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3500 / Intel Core i5 9400f
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 570 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, will run best on low/medium quality settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500 / Intel Core i7 9700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: SSD required, will run best on high/epic quality settings
